lines.text: Endmin, you're here! Roger and I just arrived too.
Great. The entire team is here. Should we set off?
Time to find the giant mushroom? I'm gonna help get rid of the meanies on it!
We're not sure if it's the hyphal mass... Though we got rid of the malignancy, there are still plenty of puzzles to solve.
Have faith in us. We'll handle it properly.
Yeah, Roger. We got this! Just stick around and relax. Wait for the good news!
Alright. If you run into any problems, give me a call. I'll come up with a solution.
Endmin, Kay, it's time to roll out. The hyphal mass is near the Monitoring Office at the bottom of the dam. I'll take you there.
Yeah. I rushed here immediately when I heard it might be related to Strain E21. I even shoved all my novel mycoflora collection work to my colleagues...
Having the Endmin here does give me a peace of mind... Oh yes, I even tasked Kay to carry some equipment. This is a chance to gather the latest field data.
Let me check the time. She should be here any —
Endmin! Honey waffles incoming!
Wha? Waffles? Why? How? Aren't you supposed to bring us some equipment...?
Ahem. I told her the Endmin's coming, and she asked if she could bring some freshly baked waffles along... I agreed, provided she agrees to bring some of the equipment.
Yeah! And I got Uncle Roger's equipment right here! They're super safe with the waffles.
Heheh. And I'm super happy! I got to join a new adventure with Endmin!
Given the situation before, I'll take the role of contact point ... and trust you people with the field investigation work.

options: Thank you, Kay. You did well.
Appreciate the waffles. We're counting on you this time too.

lines.text: Endmin, look! That's the hyphal mass I've found...
How did it reach this deep?! This is my first time seeing them grow like that...
Hmm... This does look like Strain E21's hyphae. And it's still trying to grow downwards. The source of this growth should be deeper inside.
Deeper inside? Roger told me that this used to be a UWST research site. There are more lab floors for at least a hundred feet downwards. Quite a waste to abandon them all...
Only way to find out is to keep heading down. Maybe we'll find some clues along the way.
Yeah. Hope so... Right, Endmin, Kay, I remember we got an elevator over there. We can check that out.
Roger is right. This place can really throw you off... I had seen quite a few sites, but this is the messiest floor plan ever.
Yeah. It's like a giant maze...! But the giant shroom's roots seem to know where it wants to go. And that's down, down, down...
Endmin, from what Kay observed, perhaps Strain E21's hyphae ... is exhibiting awareness about its growth.
Maybe I should call it a form of growth tropism. It is being guided by something.
I KNOW! Giant shroom is hungry for something! There's something super delish down there!
Wha? Do mushrooms eat?
I believe the growth tropism of this organism ... is guided by a specific "stimulus"... Just like how honey waffles work on Kay. This stimulus must be irresistible.
Hey. I see dark stuff floating in the water...
Looks like old UWST equipment. The marks along the edges ... perhaps the hyphal mass damaged it. I wonder if the place has useful data for us...
It might... But I got a feeling ... there's still a big place below this.
It's the dam's design plan... So a special Waste Disposal Zone lies in the bottom-most section of the dam. Perhaps that's what the hyphal mass is aiming for.
Oh. But from what I see, the way there is underwater too... To reach this bottom-most section, we'll need to pump out the water from the archive...
The Control Room archive is just ahead. But like you see...
Sivka! Endmin! Look! I found a treasure map!
No rush... According to the design plan, the topmost portion of the Control Room has an Emergency Discharge Unit just to handle floods like this. Let's take a look.
Say Endmin, do you know what's the favorite food of the giant mushroom?
Your words are so wise, Endmin! But I don't think the giant shroom can smell or taste anything...
Does it like sweet things like honey waffles? Or bitter ickies like herbs?
Maybe it understands flavors differently. What it smells or eats can be very different from us.

options: Maybe it's got a sweet tooth like Kay.
Maybe its taste is inhuman and like bitter stuff.

lines.text: Ugh. It's so stinky... I hate this smell...
Sure it smells a little weird. But I've read the reports and this ... doesn't smell that bad.
Wait. Strain E21 got really big and its hyphae are still growing. Can it be...?
Yeah. Perhaps it realized how rich this fertilizer is...
Heheh! I knew it! Giant shroom was just trying to find its favorite "waffle"!
Fine. Our noses are working but we're not dying and retching... This stink mix probably mellowed out by a lot. Perhaps E21 had a hand in this too.
Oh? Are we gathering the fertilizer left-behinds for Uncle Roger?
I don't think fungi have olfactory senses. Strain E21 probably regards the fertilizer like a honey waffle.
I have a feeling ... that the malodorous volatiles have been neutralized by E21 when it absorbed the fertilizer.
But how did it do that...? I guess I'll just gather a few samples and let Roger do his egghead thing.
Yeah. Once we're done bagging the stuff, please take it back to Roger.
Endmin, how did it go? Sivka told me you recovered some samples.
Yeah. Kay is carrying them. They're yours to study now.
Here, Uncle Roger. This is the giant mushroom's "honey waffle".
"Honey waffle"? Wait. Is this the fertilizer you mentioned?
So that's what happened back then... No wonder. My instructor always looked disgusted at every mention of Incident L329. I think he was amongst the crew sent to clean the stink.
He must have been through a lot...
Ahem. Nevertheless, this sample is extremely valuable! Your postulations might very well be true...
Strain E21 has exhibited outstanding performance in breaking down certain chemicals. Further research might give us a rich fertilizer minus the bad stench...
Yeah. We discovered the "culprit" that allowed E21 to reach its gargantuan proportions. It was the Prototype Fertilizer all along.
It gave off such an insane stink that the scientists back then decided to bury it for good. But it was so rich and caught the attention of E21.
Strain E21 requires vast amounts of nutrients. This fertilizer was the perfect source, and so it kept trying to grow its hyphae downwards —
Most of the fertilizers are still buried in the Waste Disposal Zone at the bottom-most section of the dam.
In any case, your work is much appreciated, people! We made excellent progress in both dam repairs as well as the study of the new fungal strain.
(Reports comparing various crops yields... The data was generated more than a decade ago.)
Endmin, I'm just making wild guesses here... I got a feeling that Strain E21 probably got its eyes on a secret weapon, one that UWST might be working on at this installation.
Secret weapon...? But I thought the dam focused on agricultural research.
I believe the agro science is just a cover up... And Incident L329 proves there's more going on. The way that got handled was pretty sneaky...
Those who worked on it got real quiet. They prolly forced the crew to sign some NDA...
But the things I saw in this trip ... revealed to me that L329 probably involved materials of mass destruction... Something that must not be released into the world...
And that something must be a secret weapon. That's why incident containment and clean-up were so secretive...
Endmin, are we gonna hit the ultimate bottom of this dam? I'm so excited!
I hope we can fix this for good ... and pray that nothing bad happens.
Good job! Those guys were a real headache. Thank goodness I got you around...
Heheh. Don't worry! Team Endmin and Kay can take on anything and win!
Hmm. That should be its source... There might be data files nearby. Maybe they will tell us something useful.
Now it's time to take on the problem surrounding Strain E21 hyphal mass...
